label: ISR 4331 branch router
description: Sub-2 Gbps branch services router: 100 Mbps of CEF/IPsec forwarding in the base licence, 300 Mbps with the FL-4330-PERF licence and up to 1.8 Gbps with the booster licence. Three onboard dual-mode GE ports (an RJ-45 and an SFP cage on the same port number, one media active at a time) plus a dedicated GE management port, with two NIM slots, one ISC slot and one SM-X slot for WAN, voice and switching modules.
notes: ISR4331/K9: "3 onboard GE, 2 NIM slots, 1 ISC slot, 1 SM slot". Hardware installation guide, "Dual Mode GE or SFP Ports": the SFP cage shares the physical port with the RJ-45 of the same number and only one media can be active, so each GE port is modelled as a combo pair. GigabitEthernet0 is the separate 10/100/1000 management port. The SFP cages accept 1000BASE-SX/LX/ZX and 100 Mb/s SFPs; PoE+ is not fitted on the 4331 (only 4451-X and 4351 have front-panel PoE+).
